title: 第9章 就她这脑子啧啧啧第10章 压不下的冲动
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 这钱，并不是奖励，是警告。
意思是以后不能因为这种事再耽误工作了。
“谢谢丁管事！”苏芽芽连忙点头，“您放心，我，我知道了。”
以后她一定会非常小心。
这次能不挨打，把这件事糊弄过去，已经是非常不容易。
眼下，手头还能留下三百。
不管是奖励，还是警告。
这可是实在在的钱啊！
苏芽芽难掩兴奋地把钱叠好，放进口袋，把拉锁拉好，确保不会掉出来。
拉好以后，她又隔着衣服摸了摸钱，才去拿拖把，准备拖地上的血。
她一转头，正看到丁管事怪模怪样地盯着她。
“丁管事，您还有什么吩咐？”苏芽芽心里咯噔一下，该不会是看穿她鞋里有金饼了吧？
“没事。”丁管事摇摇头。
他扫了一圈场地，眼皮子一抬，“把那边也收拾了。”
“是！”苏芽芽赶紧应下，埋头苦干起来。
丁管事看着她正认真地拖地，转头就要走，正看到码放得着整整齐齐的角落。
这个角落就在今天早上还不是这个样子，堆放着一些材料。
别的管事甚至调侃，说他对苏芽芽这个小傻子太宽容。
殊不知像苏芽芽这种手下，是让他最省心的类型。
她个头小，力气也不大，脑子也不算聪明。
但她眼里有活，重点是做事非常踏实，一点也不偷奸耍滑。
多脏多累的活，她从来不抱怨一句，只是老老实实地按照要求完成。
他刚刚还在怀疑她是不是自己私藏了一份钱，但是看她那宝贝钱的小动作。
就三百块，都稀罕得不知道怎么办才好了，生怕丢了。
就她那个脑子和胆子。
肯定是没藏钱。
丁管事转头看到有两个喽啰在嘀嘀咕咕，骂了一声，就冲着那两个扎眼的蠢货抽了两鞭。
苏芽芽连多看一眼都不敢，赶紧把这一片都收拾好，才坐下喘口气。
其实她现在已经饿过头了。
但是还不到饭点，喽啰是不能吃饭的。
不过她有办法。
她钻到角落里拿工具的空档，给自己嘴里放了个小糖块。
糖块在口腔化开，甜甜的味道充斥着口腔。
这感觉太好了。
这里虽然脏乱差，性命依旧处在危险的境地。
但是她现在的情况是生活有奔头，吃饭有保障。
甚至安全性都比末世高好多。
与其沮丧地度过这五年，还不如想办法让自己快乐一点。
她心情超好地踩着金饼，继续清扫角落。
密切盯着监控的几个管事看了半天，也没看到她有什么奇怪的动作。
“我就说你们都别指望这个傻子藏钱。”丁主管巡场一圈，到了监控室就看到好几个管事在盯着苏芽芽头顶的监控，“就她那脑子，指定藏不住。”
content_en:
This money is not a reward, but a warning.
This means that we can no longer delay work because of this kind of thing.
"Thank you, Manager Ding!" Su Yaya nodded quickly, "Don't worry, I, I understand."
She will definitely be very careful in the future.
It was already very difficult to get past this without getting beaten this time.
Right now, I still have three hundred left on hand.
Whether it's a reward or a warning.
This is real money!
Su Yaya couldn't hide her excitement as she folded the money, put it in her pocket, and zipped it up to make sure it wouldn't fall out.
After pulling it up, she touched the money through her clothes before going to get a mop to mop the blood on the floor.
She turned her head and saw Manager Ding staring at her strangely.
"Manager Ding, do you have any other orders?" Su Yaya's heart skipped a beat. Could it be that she saw that there was a gold cake in her shoe?
"It's okay." Manager Ding shook his head.
He scanned the area, raised his eyelids, and said, "Take care of that area too."
"Yes!" Su Yaya quickly agreed and started working hard.
Manager Ding looked at her mopping the floor seriously, turned around to leave, and saw the neatly stacked corners.
This corner didn't look like this just this morning, with some materials piled up.
Other stewards even teased him, saying that he was too tolerant of Su Yaya, a little fool.
Little did he know that subordinates like Su Yaya were the type of people who made him worry the most.
She is small, not very strong, and not very bright.
But she has life in her eyes, and the important thing is that she is very down-to-earth in her work and is not sneaky at all.
She never complained about the dirty and tiring work, she just completed it honestly as required.
He was still doubting whether she had hidden some money for herself just now, but look at her little actions with the precious money.
It's only three hundred yuan, so rare that I don't know what to do with it, for fear of losing it.
Just her brains and courage.
There must be no money hidden.
Manager Ding turned around and saw two minions muttering. He cursed and whipped the two dazzling fools twice.
Su Yaya didn't even dare to take another look. She quickly packed everything up before sitting down and taking a breath.
In fact, she is too hungry now.
But it’s not yet dinner time, so I can’t eat.
But she has a solution.
She got into the corner to get the tools and put a small candy cube in her mouth.
The candy melted in the mouth, filling the mouth with a sweet taste.
It feels so good.
Although this place is dirty and messy, lives are still in danger.
But her current situation is that she has a head start in life and food security.
Even the security is much higher than that of the apocalypse.
Instead of spending these five years depressed, you might as well find ways to make yourself happier.
She stepped on the golden cake in a very good mood and continued to clean the corners.
The stewards who watched her closely for a long time did not see any strange movements on her part.
"I'm telling you, don't expect this fool to hide money." Director Ding made a tour of the site. When he arrived at the monitoring room, he saw several supervisors staring at the monitor above Su Yaya's head. "With her brain, she can't hide it."
title_en: Chapter 9: Her brain sucks. Chapter 10: Uncontrollable impulse.
